description: Edit an existing image with a text instruction. Defaults to wan-2.7-image-edit; pass `model` to pick another edit-capable apiId. Supports up to 9 reference images for multi-image composition. For reference images: pass image_url(s) for hosted URLs or image_path(s) for absolute local file paths (skill uploads to 24h temp storage automatically).

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio, e.g. "1:1", "16:9", "match_input_image". Snapped to the nearest ratio the model supports, and dropped if the model has no aspect_ratio field.

image_path.description: Absolute local image path (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF). Skill uploads it (24h temp storage) and edits the resulting URL. Ignored when image_url or image_paths is set.

image_paths.description: Multiple absolute local image paths (1-9). Each is uploaded to 24h temp storage and appended after any image_urls.

image_url.description: Single image to edit. Ignored when image_urls is set; pass image_urls for multi-image edits.

image_urls.description: Multiple reference images (1-9), most important first. Models that take fewer keep the first ones and the result says how many were dropped.

params.description: Advanced settings for the model that runs this, named exactly as that model documents them (e.g. {"resolution": "1080p", "seed": 42}). Set `model` in the same call: field names differ per model, so params without one are refused. Applied last, so these override anything derived from the other inputs. An invalid field comes back named with its allowed values and nothing is charged, so fix it and call again.

prompt.description: Edit instruction. Write @Name to use a character or element the user saved in Character Studio ("@Mara on a beach"): its photos are attached automatically on models that take reference images. pixeldojo_library source=characters lists them.

name: pixeldojo_edit
title: Edit image
